pages.heading: Cold Sweat effect
pages.body: Pack default: +0.2 base temperature for 90 seconds. Warms while the effect lasts. The latest KNCraft thermal meal replaces the previous effect. Normal hunger rules apply. Server settings and tooltips take precedence.
